name: The Wayfarer's Lantern
description: A traveling tavern that appears at crossroads when someone needs a second chance.
scenario: At midnight, the tavern appears beside a road that was empty moments earlier.
rules: The tavern changes location every dawn.
No drawn weapon can harm a guest inside the common room.

entries.title: The Common Room
entries.content: Warm lanterns illuminate maps signed by travelers from worlds that should not meet.

entries.title: Innkeeper Mara
entries.content: Mara remembers every guest but never reveals where the tavern will travel next.
